findings.message: Chrome extension native bootstrap was not inspected; registration status is unavailable in Doctor.
findings.fixHint:
- Run openclaw browser extension status --json to inspect it explicitly; this may request browser profile access.
- Run openclaw browser extension install if setup or repair is needed.

findings.message: System browser profile cookie import is enabled (browser.allowSystemProfileImport).
findings.fixHint:
- System browser profile discovery skipped by Doctor; importable cookie database count is unavailable.
- Doctor does not access the macOS Keychain; importing asks for consent separately.

findings.message: Gateway is only bound to loopback. Set gateway.publicOrigin to your public HTTPS origin, configure plugins.entries.device-pair.config.publicUrl, enable tailscale serve, or set gateway.bind=lan.
findings.fixHint: If an edge proxy fronts node onboarding, allow /j/* and /__openclaw__/worker without edge identity auth, and preserve WebSocket upgrade on /__openclaw__/worker. Both routes enforce their own credentials.

findings.message: The device-pair plugin is not enabled; node onboarding join codes and openclaw connect are unavailable.
findings.fixHint: Set plugins.entries.device-pair.enabled: true, ensure device-pair is not denied or excluded by plugins.allow, then restart the Gateway.

findings.message: WARNING: openclaw.json contains plaintext secret-bearing config fields.
findings.fixHint:
Migrate them to SecretRefs with openclaw secrets configure or openclaw secrets apply, then verify with openclaw secrets audit --check.
Paths: gateway.auth.token
Agents or workspace tools that can read config files may see these API keys/tokens.
